symptom: A synthetic empty Map.prototype.keys iterator erases unresolved/rejected reason and taxonomy maps during shadow evidence generation even when reconciliation reports unresolved rows. A selective Map.prototype.get override can undercount repeated reasons. The resulting generated evidence and content digest no longer reflect the reconciled reasons; semantic validation may reject the inconsistent evidence, but generation itself is not stable. No real race, private odds or production evidence was involved.
lesson: Hardening shadow-evidence taxonomy validation does not protect the builder: mutable ambient Map methods can erase or undercount reason metadata before the content digest is constructed.
guardrail: Aggregate unresolved/rejected reasons and taxonomy with null-prototype own-data count dictionaries, Reflect.ownKeys and own-descriptor reads. Preserve the ordinary serialized map shape and digest. Regress empty Map.keys and selective Map.get overrides; never interpret synthetic evidence as real K-source authorization.
